page.layout: One page of running text, with two marginal notes in the left margin beside the paragraph "Cum Deus". Running head at top, page number at top left of the text block, no catchword except one at the foot right.

main_text.p: 1. Sunt testimonia de nostra salute & eius causis antegresfis. Cum enim ad sanctificationem proprie spectent, κατ' ἀ-νάλυσιν [?] ex illa iustificatio, ex iustificatione uocatio, & ex hac electio colligitur. Rom.8.30.
2. Deus ea mercede gratuita remunera ri dignatur. Itaque fructu non carent.
3. Seruiunt aedificationi proximorum, iuxta dictum: Sic splendeat lux uestra, ut uideant homines bona uestra opera, & glorificent Patrem uestrum qui est in coelis. Matt.5.16.

Hæc breuiter attingere uisum est in tā-ta temporis angustia. Dominus Iesus det, ut inoffenso cursu per bonorum operum stadium festinemus ad coelestem patriā, cuius ius & possessionem sanguinis sui pretiosi λύτρῳ Christus Dominus nobis parauit. Amen.
main_text.head: II. DE FIRMITATE PRO-positi & decreti diuini.
main_text.p: Lectio 56. 11. Maij.Cum Deus sui propositi fine nunquam frustretur, eo quod is & omniscius & omnipotens est: ἀμεταμέλητος ἡ μὴ παλινάγρητον [?] est, quicquid ille se facturum denunciat. Sic ergo illa Scripturae loca, in qui-bus

page.notes: Marginal note "Lectio 56." is uncertain: the numeral could be 36 or 56. The date "11. Maij." is partly obscured. Greek in the "κατ' ἀ-νάλυσιν" line and in "ἀμεταμέλητος ἡ μὴ παλινάγρητον" is hard to read at this scan resolution and is marked [?]. The word "tā-ta" is taken as the abbreviated form of "tanta". The heading may be level 1 if it opens a new division; I took it as level 2 inside the Praelectiones. Some of the page margin is stained, and faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
